description: Max 3 contacts per borrower per day across ALL channels, agents and accounts.

Max 5 call contact(s) per borrower per rolling 7 days.

Max 5 sms contact(s) per borrower per rolling 7 days.

Max 3 whatsapp contact(s) per borrower per rolling 7 days.

Max 3 email contact(s) per borrower per rolling 7 days.
Max 1 field_visit contact(s) per borrower per day.
Max 2 field_visit contact(s) per borrower per rolling 7 days.
At least 60 minutes between call attempts to the same borrower.
At least 30 minutes between any two contacts to the same borrower.
Bucket 0: max 1 contact(s) per day. Effective cap = min(global, channel, bucket).
Bucket 0: max 3 contacts per rolling 7 days.
Bucket 1-30: max 2 contact(s) per day. Effective cap = min(global, channel, bucket).
Bucket 1-30: max 6 contacts per rolling 7 days.
Bucket 31-60: max 3 contact(s) per day. Effective cap = min(global, channel, bucket).
Bucket 31-60: max 9 contacts per rolling 7 days.
Bucket 61-90: max 3 contact(s) per day. Effective cap = min(global, channel, bucket).
Bucket 61-90: max 10 contacts per rolling 7 days.
Bucket 90+: max 2 contact(s) per day. Effective cap = min(global, channel, bucket).
Bucket 90+: max 6 contacts per rolling 7 days.
Caps count per BORROWER across all their accounts, not per account.
No-answer, busy, switched-off and failed deliveries count toward the caps.
Exactly one agent owns a borrower at a time; only the owner may contact.
A contact by a non-owner is blocked and logged with the owner id as the reason.
Ownership is per borrower, so a lock covers all the borrower's accounts.
An ownership lease expires after 24 hours unless renewed by the owner.
When two agents compete, the higher priority wins; handoff needs supervisor approval.
legal_flag = 1: only legal_agent may contact; all others blocked and rerouted.

Service / transactional voice calls go out on a 1600-series number (phased deadlines by lender type; L01 assumed covered from Feb 2026).

description: Deceased borrower: block every outbound channel; route to the legal-heir desk only.

Open PTP: no recovery contact from any agent until the day after the promised date.

A broken PTP moves ownership to negotiation_agent within 1 day.
A new PTP replaces any older open PTP on the same account.

description: Successful payment: stop contact on the account for 48 hours pending reconciliation.
If the payment is reversed (reversal_flag=1), the hold ends and contact may resume.
A payment that cannot be matched to an account puts the likely borrower on review hold.
call, sms and whatsapp need a phone on D2.

Field visits only from the 31-60 bucket onward.

Bucket to SMA mapping: SMA-0 = 1-30, SMA-1 = 31-60, SMA-2 = 61-90 days overdue.

legal_agent may contact a borrower only at 90+ days or when legal_flag = 1.
Tele-calling starts from DPD 15; before that, digital reminders.
reminder_agent is not used beyond 60 days overdue.
External agencies handle calls and field visits only, never bucket 0.
Legal notice preparation starts at 61-90 days; no borrower contact.

source_ref: RBI recovery directions (issued 6 Aug 2026, effective 1 Jan 2027)
description: Agent targets and incentives must not reward threats or excessive contact.
Every routing decision must complete within 100 ms.
No heartbeat for 60 s: mark the agent crashed, release its lease, resume from last saved state.
More than 2 identical actions on a borrower in an hour: quarantine the agent for that borrower.
Malformed agent output is retried twice, then escalated to a human queue.
Per-agent daily attempt budgets and costs live in D13.
Every routing decision is logged with the rule_id(s) that caused it.
